dedupe_keys.name: annotated iot dataset of waste collection events

description: The AI4WASTE project publishes multimodal sensor streams and labelled bin-emptying events from eight waste collection vehicles. The GitHub repository arranges three CSV tables by vehicle: collection events, sensor status messages and raw sensor readings. The article reports 12,391 events, with five vehicles observed for 25 collection days in total and three video-validated vehicles for eight days. Sensors recorded GPS, vehicle speed, lifting-arm acceleration, radar and RFID values at a nominal half-second interval. The geographic coverage is the participating operator routes; their exact area is not stated on the resource page. GitHub identifies CC BY 4.0 and provides free public access. The data can calibrate event-detection models or test waste-service operations in urban simulations. RFID cross-talk, repeated lifts and unsynchronised arm sensors can produce ambiguous labels; the article reports weaker agreement for non-RFID events. The CSV files were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. Use of the labels as exact lift counts is limited when RFID is absent.
name: Annotated IoT Dataset of Waste Collection Events
notes: G4-0518; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
